discovery: Controlled/living radical polymerization, in particular transition-metal-catalyzed atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP), which enables precise synthesis of polymers with designed architectures
rationale: After recent prizes in biochemistry (2024), MOFs (2025), and nanomaterials (2023), the committee may turn to synthetic polymer chemistry. Since the mid-1990s, ATRP has become one of the most cited and industrially used methods in chemistry. Both pioneers have won major prizes, including the Wolf Prize, and are widely seen as long-overdue Nobel candidates.
